e754628c14.q: What framework helps explain why positive and negative commercial real estate signals occur simultaneously?
e754628c14.a: Stephen Bushbaum developed a three-clock system framework: the property clock dealing with leasing, occupancy, and property fundamentals; the capital clock dealing with capital market conditions, underlying coupons, refinancing conditions, and loan structure timing; and the credit clock tracking payment status from watch list through delinquency to foreclosure. Maturity is described as the great synchronization event that forces all three clocks to come into sync.

69e6c23053.a: Genesis Towers demonstrates strong credit metrics with a debt service coverage ratio of 3.11 times coverage and current LTV of 44.2%, but faces significant operational challenges.
